::: {.callout-important}
This real-study section is a scaffold. No real dataset or real findings are bundled yet.
:::

After completing the provenance and validation steps:

```bash
python scripts/python/run_workflow.py --data-dir data/real-study --output-dir results/real-study
```

Before publishing, add the real figures to these pages, explain their patterns, and add their PNG paths to the `resources` list in `_quarto.yml`. Verify exact variant counts and all captions. These pages currently make no biological claims.
